scoped.notes: secrets.NPM_TOKEN is a granular access token scoped to the nebutra npm org. It can publish @nebutra/* and cannot PUT unscoped names.

unscoped.name: create-sailor
unscoped.reason: npm create sailor requires the unscoped name. An org-scoped granular token returns E404 on PUT https://registry.npmjs.org/create-sailor.

unscoped.name: nebutra
unscoped.reason: CLI binary name. Same identity split as create-sailor.
